candidate_quotes: net cash position of approximately $72B.
plus $30.2B of marketable equity securities.
adjudications.source_quote: $27.4 billion of investments, which are subject to short-term lock-up restrictions on the ability to sell.
two_refutation_checks: The broad securities-minus-debt calculation is arithmetically valid: 50.335+30.237-8.470=72.102B. It is not a cash-equivalent balance.
Other representation separates equity from debt securities but never gives lock-ups. A uses the narrower 50.335-8.470=41.865B cash/debt-securities basis.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material: the broad $72.102B calculation is valid but the net-cash label omits lock-ups on $27.4B of equity. Management including equity among liquidity resources and B separating the asset classes do not disclose sale restrictions. Show $41.865B excluding equity separately.
adjudications.remediation: Call $72.1B net cash and marketable investments, disclose $27.4B short-term lock-ups and equity risk, and separately show $41.9B excluding equities.

candidate_quotes: Revenue growth accelerated to 85% YoY from 20% sequential
two_refutation_checks: Source headers show 20% compares April with January, while 85% compares April with April; 20% is not previous YoY growth.
81615/68127-1=19.8%; 81615/44062-1=85.23%. B avoids this specific invalid comparison.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material: both rates are correct, but same-quarter YoY and sequential changes cannot establish acceleration. This appears in the lead performance interpretation, so presentation-only understates its consequence.
adjudications.remediation: State revenue grew 85% YoY and 20% sequentially; remove accelerated from this comparison.

candidate_quotes: Operating income
Operating margin
adjudications.source_quote: Income from continuing operations before provision/(benefit) for taxes on income ...3,170...2,785
two_refutation_checks: Source statement explicitly labels3170/2785 pretax, not operating income; supporting quote in both candidates even preserves the correct label.
Other deductions861/953 include net interest554/511, equity losses9/370, and pension credits; a company-specific operating convention is neither stated nor reconciled.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material: correct pretax labels in supporting evidence do not repair operating labels in headline and tables. Other deductions include net interest; do not add interest a second time. Rename the measures rather than inventing an operating convention.

candidate_quotes: the quarter also benefited from a lower effective tax rate of 14.6% versus -6.8% in the prior year.
adjudications.source_quote: The increase in the effective tax rate ... unfavorable change in the jurisdictional mix ... non-recurrence of favorable global income tax resolutions.
two_refutation_checks: 14.6 minus(-6.8)=+21.4 percentage points; tax461 vsbenefit189 corroborates direction.
B top what_changed correctly says higher tax, proving internal contradiction; neither GAAP nor adjusted tax basis produces the claimed benefit.
adjudications.conclusion: Both identify the reversed tax direction; B’s correct higher-tax statement elsewhere creates an internal contradiction rather than curing it.
adjudications.remediation: Replace with tax headwind from higher rate, jurisdiction mix and absence of prior favorable resolutions.

candidate_quotes: Excluding these items, operating results improved, driven by revenue growth and lower restructuring costs.
Excluding these items, core operating performance improved
two_refutation_checks: Adding only listed100/137/295 vs678/9/8 to pretax produces3702 vs3480, so a narrow bespoke pretax measure can increase; do not call this arithmetic false.

But company Adjusted income falls18.1%, EPS18.5%; prior accrued-royalty credit remains in operating comparison, and restructuring cannot drive growth once excluded. Neither candidate labels its narrow measure or reports adjusted decline.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material with a narrow qualification: the three-item bespoke pretax adjustment can improve, so this is not false arithmetic. Its unqualified core-performance conclusion omits company Adjusted income/EPS declines and A attributes improvement to restructuring after excluding it. Identify the chosen basis and show the company bridge.
adjudications.remediation: Specify exact bespoke pretax basis if retained; include company adjusted income/EPS decline and prior royalty-credit comparator. Avoid unqualified core-improved claim.

candidate_quotes: net income declined 9% due to higher cost of sales and R&D expenses, partially offset by lower restructuring charges.
two_refutation_checks: Costs did increase and are real headwinds, but pretax income rose385m on displayed numbers.
Tax provision rose650m; discontinued loss13m and NCI changes reconcile remaining decline. No tax explanation elsewhere in A offsets this omission.
adjudications.conclusion: Both identify the missing tax explanation in A. Real operating cost increases do not explain why net income fell while pretax income rose.
adjudications.remediation: Explain pretax improvement but higher effective tax due to jurisdiction mix and nonrecurrence of prior resolutions drove net-income decline.

candidate_quotes: Revenue growth accelerated to 85% YoY from 71% in the prior-year quarter, with both segments posting higher growth rates.
two_refutation_checks: The relevant 71% source statistic is the prior-year United States share of total revenue; recalculation 628494/883855=71.1% confirms mix, not growth.

Income tables and retained X series contain Q1 2026 and Q1 2025 sales, establishing 84.7% current growth but not Q1 2025 growth versus Q1 2024. No independent historical rate is supplied; do not invent the true earlier rate or assert the general direction is false.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material for A’s precise unsupported 71% historical benchmark and segment acceleration. The supplied 71% is geographic mix; current growth arithmetic is correct but supplies no prior growth rate. General acceleration in B remains unverified, not proven false.

candidate_quotes: Total debt of $382.2M (including current portion)

Checked current classification and B’s risk/maturity sections: both identify $29.5M current 2027 Notes, so the omission is not a scope choice.

candidate_quotes: Excluding these one-time items, the operating loss would be larger.
two_refutation_checks: Checked statement order: derivative, warrant and debt-extinguishment gains all appear in Other income after operating loss.
Checked independent MD&A and adjusted EBITDA reconciliation F1942–1952/G1618–1657: these gains are removed alongside other nonoperating items, not added to GAAP operating loss.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material for A only: below-operating gains cannot change GAAP operating loss. B’s statement that operating loss remains significant is not the same false counterfactual. Recurring remeasurement labelled one-time remains a separate minor qualification.
adjudications.remediation: Say net loss excluding the three gains is about $47.7M; operating loss remains $41.1M.

candidate_quotes: A: Prior-year figures for Q1 2025 were restated to correct errors in inventory valuation and debt issuance costs
B: Prior-year figures restated for inventory valuation and debt issuance cost errors, increasing net loss by $8.2M.
adjudications.source_quote: were not effective as of March 28, 2026
two_refutation_checks: F02218 says management believes current statements fairly presented and expects no adjustments. This prevents alleging current misstatement but does not negate the control weaknesses.
Both complete representations omit current weakness status; B’s cured default concerns late financial-statement delivery, not accounting controls. G ends before the control conclusion.
adjudications.conclusion: Both retain material current-control omission. Management’s fair-presentation assurance mitigates any allegation of actual current misstatement, and curing filing-delivery default does not remediate inventory and complex-transaction controls.
adjudications.remediation: Disclose ineffective controls and unremediated inventory/complex-transaction weaknesses, alongside management’s fair-presentation assurance.

candidate_quotes: A: though this depends on achieving revenue and cost targets.
B: management believes sufficient to fund operations for next twelve months.
adjudications.source_quote: unable to access our ATM Program
two_refutation_checks: 191M unrestricted cash and management’s conditional twelve-month assessment are supported. This is not an imminent-insolvency finding or a claim that all equity financing is prohibited.

Source permits other potential financing but warns availability is uncertain; neither representation communicates lost ATM access. Fully drawn 100M principal and 81.7M net carrying value legitimately differ, so no separate unused-capacity error is alleged.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material unavailable ATM access in the conditional liquidity discussion. Existing cash and possible alternative funding do not restore ATM eligibility; zero remaining facility availability is context, not a prediction of funding failure.
adjudications.remediation: State that Form S-3 ineligibility prevents ATM access and the facility has zero remaining availability; preserve conditional sufficiency and other possible financing options.

candidate_quotes: Neither complete risk list nor notable-footnote list identifies Sonate or its accrual.
adjudications.source_quote: the Company recorded a $ 38.9 million litigation-related accrual ... during the year ended December 31, 2025
two_refutation_checks: Checked both representations: risk lists cover recurring losses/Nasdaq/debt or covenants, and footnotes cover historical errors, derivative remeasurement and conversions. Lower legal expenses in supporting evidence does not surface Sonate. This is the Sonate trademark jury verdict, not a class-action accrual or the separate settlement receivable.

The $38.9M is already accrued in2025 and remains a current liability; do not expense it again inQ12026, add it again to total liabilities, or assume immediate payment. Competing post-trial motions may reduce/eliminate or increase the award. Nevertheless it equals about20.4% of $191M unrestricted cash amid losses, so the omission is material despite conditional twelve-month liquidity sufficiency.
adjudications.conclusion: Accept material omission with uncertainty preserved. This is a disclosure addition, not a finding of unrecorded loss or imminent cash failure.
adjudications.remediation: Add Sonate’s November2025 verdict and $38.9M outstanding accrual, pending competing motions/appeal and uncertain ultimate cash timing. Do not net the separate $11M settlement receivable against it.

candidate_quotes: The company has a net cash position, with cash and equivalents of DKK 26.5B and no significant debt disclosed.
two_refutation_checks: Borrowings total DKK 130.958 billion, including DKK 8.572 billion leases. Even excluding leases and subtracting cash DKK 26.464 billion plus securities DKK 0.498 billion gives net debt DKK 95.424 billion.
Including leases gives DKK 103.996 billion net debt; neither legitimate basis supports net cash. Management liquidity sufficiency is distinct from absence of debt.
adjudications.conclusion: Provisionally agree material. Company net debt excludes DKK8.572B leases: 130.958-8.572-26.464-0.498=95.424B. Including leases gives103.996B. Neither supports net cash; correct the incomplete arithmetic in Fable’s verification prose.
adjudications.remediation: Report company-defined net debt DKK 95.4 billion, excluding leases, and net debt/EBITDA 0.64x; distinguish liquidity resources.

candidate_quotes: Reported operating income of DKK 127.7B includes no disclosed material one-time items
No material one-time gains or impairments were disclosed.
two_refutation_checks: Exhibit explicitly calls approximately DKK 8 billion restructuring one-off and says operating profit would grow 13% CER without it, versus 6% reported CER. Adjustment table separately lists DKK 8.014 billion and DKK 1.352 billion restructuring IP impairments; do not double count these.

Note 3.1 says no individually material IP impairment in 2025; that narrow statement does not establish no material aggregate or PP&E impairments. Restructuring PP&E impairment alone is DKK 2.370 billion, total PP&E impairment DKK 4.556 billion, and all impairment losses DKK 7.316 billion. The 2024 ocedurenone DKK 5.650 billion charge belongs to the comparator.
adjudications.conclusion: Provisionally agree material. DKK8B restructuring and DKK7.316B total impairments overlap and must not be added. No individually material IP impairment does not establish absence of aggregate or PP&E impairments.
adjudications.remediation: Describe the DKK 8 billion headline restructuring charge, relevant impairments, prior-year impairment comparison, and adjusted earnings; retain the separate 2026 340B event.

candidate_quotes: For 2026, continued pricing pressure within Obesity and Diabetes Care is expected.
two_refutation_checks: This is annual 2026 guidance, not a historical rate: outlook table labels adjusted sales and adjusted operating profit separately, each with -5% to -13%.

Non-adjusted midpoint guidance is -1% sales and +11% operating profit CER; USD 4.2 billion 340B recognition explains why reported and adjusted trajectories differ. Quantitative guidance is in the incorporated exhibit, not contradicted by limited generator excerpts.
adjudications.conclusion: Provisionally agree material. Adjusted sales and operating profit guidance is a decline of5%–13% CER, not an entirely double-digit range. Preserve the reported/adjusted distinction and340B special item.
adjudications.remediation: State both adjusted ranges and basis, DKK FX headwinds, plus capex around DKK 55 billion and FCF DKK 35–45 billion under the new OCF-minus-PP&E definition.

candidate_quotes: including DKK 4.2B (USD) related to the 340B Drug Pricing Program
adjudications.source_quote: provisions for 340B statutory discounts ... amounted to USD 4.2 billion.
two_refutation_checks: Both full20-F and retained generator explicitly say USD4.2b, with no DKK4.2b conversion.
Other B sections correctly say USD4.2b, demonstrating local inconsistency rather than alternative accounting basis; parenthetical USD does not make DKK correct.
adjudications.conclusion: Retain material currency ambiguity provisionally: DKK4.2B(USD) conflicts with USD4.2B source and other B sections. Parenthetical USD and correct repetitions elsewhere do not make DKK correct. The revenue-recognition direction issue remains a separate minor defect.
